0022600131.text: The Portland Trail Blazers (2-0) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (3-0) for their third game of the 2026-27 season. Portland, 2nd in the Northwest and 1 game back and 4th in the West, has won two straight, while the Lakers, 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West, have won three straight and are 2-0 at home. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Trail Blazers won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026. Out for Portland are Chris Youngblood (ankle, soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique, strain).
